request.raw_request: Add Patient Financial Class to the AR Aging Report
request.business_reason: Needed for payer analysis to split AR aging by payer mix

column.definition: Patient Financial Classification used to group accounts by the primary funding source (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Self Pay, Workers Comp).

related_tickets.summary: Load patient financial class into the patient dimension
related_tickets.notes: Financial class sourced from the patient master feed; values standardised to the Revenue Integrity domain list.

related_tickets.summary: AR Aging Report balance reconciliation variance after aging bucket change
related_tickets.notes: Root cause was a re-run of the fact load without clearing the prior snapshot, which double counted balances. Reconciliation of charges, payments, adjustments and balances is now mandatory for every AR change.

related_tickets.summary: Add payer analysis page to AR Aging Report
related_tickets.notes: Established the pattern of adding dimension attributes to rcm.vw_ar_detail before surfacing them in the dataset.

related_tickets.summary: Business request: financial class breakdown for payer analysis
related_tickets.notes: Finance wants AR aging split by patient financial class for the monthly payer mix review.

related_documents.title: AR Aging Report Technical Design
related_documents.content: AR Aging Report is sourced from rcm.vw_ar_detail and rcm.vw_ar_aging_summary through the pb_ar_aging import dataset. Balances are snapshotted nightly by rcm.sp_load_ar_fact. Any structural change requires a financial reconciliation of charges, payments, adjustments, denials and balances before deployment.

related_documents.title: RCM Warehouse Standards
related_documents.content: Dimension attributes surfaced on fact tables must be denormalised in the loading stored procedure rather than joined at the reporting layer. Every fact table column addition requires a migration script, a rollback script and unit tests for null, duplicate and datatype validation.

related_documents.title: Power BI Deployment Runbook
related_documents.content: Dataset schema changes require a semantic model refresh in the RCM Analytics workspace, validation of impacted measures, and a published validation report comparing pre-change and post-change totals.

-- Restore view rcm.vw_ar_detail
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rcm.vw_ar_detail AS
SELECT
    f.claim_id,
    p.patient_id,
    p.patient_name,
    pay.payer_name,
    f.charge_amount,
    f.payment_amount,
    f.adjustment_amount,
    f.denial_amount,
    f.balance,
    f.aging_bucket
FROM rcm.fact_ar f
JOIN rcm.dim_patient p ON p.patient_key = f.patient_key
JOIN rcm.dim_payer pay ON pay.payer_key = f.payer_key;

-- Restore stored_procedure rcm.sp_load_ar_fact
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE rcm.sp_load_ar_fact()
AS $$
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM rcm.fact_ar;

    INSERT INTO rcm.fact_ar (
        ar_key,
        claim_id,
        patient_key,
        payer_key,
        charge_amount,
        payment_amount,
        adjustment_amount,
        denial_amount,
        balance,
        aging_bucket,
        load_date
    )
    SELECT
        s.ar_source_key,
        s.claim_id,
        p.patient_key,
        pay.payer_key,
        s.charge_amount,
        s.payment_amount,
        s.adjustment_amount,
        s.denial_amount,
        s.charge_amount - s.payment_amount - s.adjustment_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s.days_outstanding <= 30 THEN '0-30'
            WHEN s.days_outstanding <= 60 THEN '31-60'
            WHEN s.days_outstanding <= 90 THEN '61-90'
            ELSE '90+'
        END,
        s.service_date
    FROM staging.stg_ar_transactions s
    JOIN rcm.dim_patient p ON p.patient_id = s.patient_id
    JOIN rcm.dim_payer pay ON pay.payer_id = s.payer_id;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

ALTER TABLE rcm.fact_ar
    DROP COLUMN patient_financial_class;
